body: ## Test results of MRP using a build of this PR Label is blurry on Ubuntu 24.04 (X11 and Wayland; both behave the same): starting project w/o touching anything Flipping the checkboxes: disabling "stretch" and enabling "apply" offsets the SubViewportContainer' parent node into negative values on x and y axis on play: When enabling both, the Label inside the SubViewport is never scaled (i.e. any change to `get_window().content_scale_factor` is ignored, because it changes the root viewport's size and not scale): In SubViewportContainer: have just `stretch` enabled and set `stretch_factor` to `0.5` (while `get_window().content_scale_factor` == 0): doubles the size of the Label (and makes it blurry), but root viewport and subviewport sizes remain unchanged. Move the slider to scale Label further To halve the resolution w/o changing visual size of a Label: enable `SubViewportContainer.stretch` and set `stretch_factor` to `0.5` and use the `SubViewport.size_2d_override` to compensate the size increase by taking its auto-calculated `size` value and multiply x and y by 2.
